plates.title: Visualist interface
plates.body: The architecture of injecting music during play, together with an AI bot chat and a gaming surface, is the interface for a Visualist — or even visual. Sound, talk, and play occupy one plate. The overlay is the instrument.

plates.title: Music during play
plates.body: A client-only Web Audio / MIDI graph injects live sound into the portal without remounting the server page (RSC analogue). One AudioContext per session. Resume on gesture. MIDI note-on schedules frequency. Analyser feeds the Momentum strip.

plates.title: AI bot chat
plates.body: Chat is a research news query into the NLSAR corpus — CIM a priori, TheFormat tokenization, Noise Protocol, IoT tesseract, Bandcamp solid-state media, public socials. Empty query builds a digest. View/search only.

plates.title: Gaming surface
plates.body: Play is a session flag, not a separate product. The injector node sits over a game or portal as sound station, information portal, or simulation. Continuity holds when the operator is offline — Visualist catalog style.

plates.title: NLSAR node
plates.body: Research news generator + decentralized injector. CODE BUS :4212. Surfaces: /news /station /play /api/gravity. Later a GravityDesktop connection node. Does not replace AMC :4210 or Hollywood :4211.

plates.title: A priori CIM
plates.body: From github.com/nonlineari/cim SYSTEMS.md: RAND BlockCode Java (a priori pipeline), RAND System A (neat stacking), RAND System B (cloud collision), NLS YOLODarket STEM, NLS OSINT Agent STEM, NLS Visualist. Architecture licensed CIM v1.0.

plates.title: TheFormat · token
plates.body: Music as 4D tesseract / 6-sequence TIME FREQ AMP PHASE ENTROPY CORR. AOA recording (Jimmy Howe / Interstellar). Tokenise · mine · mint stay separate. Bandcamp holds the solid-state media (nlsrecords, nnlr).

plates.title: Noise · IoT · signaling
plates.body: SCIS Noise Protocol (XX handshake, NEAR integrity, CIM transfer XML) and SCIS-bit-IOT (tesseract + IPFS). Signaling events (KEYGEN, HANDSHAKE, NEWS, gravity_update) pulse the injector. Signal app itself is not scraped.

plates.title: Shadow pager
plates.body: This page is Section 9 of the strategic architecture — future work on iama.cc, not in the primary catalogue nav. A pager through nine plates. Offline visualist continuity: last session + generated research news keep serving when you are not live.
